siteBlock.Description of Business Type / Industry: Abecca Healthcare Limited designs and manufactures specialised, high-risk environment furniture for sectors such as mental health, corrections, and youth justice centers. The company focuses on a safety-first design philosophy, including features like foam-only structures and anti-ligature designs, and produces items such as anti-ligature mattresses, seating, tables, and bean bags from their factory in Pahiatua, New Zealand
siteBlock.Hazardous Substance Location: Type B storage at 82 Sedcole Street, Pahiatua, Pahiatua, 4910
siteBlock.Brief location summary: Abecca Healthcare Limited's manufacturing facility at 82 Sedcole Street, Pahiatua 4910, New Zealand, utilises various chemical agents in their manufacturing process that are classified under New Zealand's Hazardous Substances and New Organisms (HSNO) system. These substances include highly flammable liquids (3.1B), acute toxicity chemicals (6.1C/D), skin and eye irritants/corrosives (6.3A, 6.4A, 8.2B, 8.3A), sensitisers and chronic health hazards (6.5A/B, 6.7B, 6.9B), and ecotoxins harmful to aquatic life (9.1C). The site stores a quantity of 3350kg of class 3.1B substances which consists of a pigment, cross linker and primer. These substances are stored in a type B storage together with a known quantity of a class 6 hazardous substance. In assessment for certification is the 3350kg of Class 3.1B hazardous substances.
